title: debug - dc6529f8
description: Parent error: ValueError | Parent analysis: The execution failed with a ValueError when trying to load the test_ids.npy file. The numpy array was saved as an object array (likely because the IDs contain strings like "id_00000001"), and np.load() was called without allow_pickle=True, causing it to crash. The feature engineering and data processing completed successfully, but the training/evaluation phase never ran.
method: The code performs data preprocessing (label encoding of author target), extensive feature engineering including 32 handcrafted stylometric features (text statistics, punctuation ratios, POS-like patterns, emotional tone indicators) and 384 Sentence-BERT embeddings from all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Features are scaled with StandardScaler. The model is XGBoost (multi:softprob) with hyperparameters (max_depth=6, lr=0.1, n_estimators=500, subsample/colsample=0.8, early stopping 50 rounds). Validation uses 5-fold StratifiedKFold, and the final metric is multi-class log loss. Out-of-fold predictions are averaged and a submission CSV is generated.

title: debug - eea6410e
description: Looking at the error, the issue is clear: `AdamW` can no longer be imported from `transformers` - it's been moved to `torch.optim`. The fix is to import `AdamW` from `torch.optim` instead.
method: The code loads text data from CSV files, encodes the target labels with LabelEncoder, and tokenizes text using DistilRoBERTa tokenizer with max_length=256. It uses 5-fold StratifiedKFold cross-validation and builds a DistilRoBERTa sequence classification model with dropout regularization. Training uses AdamW optimizer with cosine learning rate schedule and warmup, gradient accumulation, mixed precision via HuggingFace Accelerator, and early stopping based on validation loss. For each fold, it trains for 5 epochs, selects the best model by validation loss, and generates test predictions averaged across folds. The final submission contains three author classes (EAP, HPL, MWS) with predicted probabilities.

title: improve - aca1e878
method: Data preprocessing involves loading train/test CSV files, label encoding the 3-class target column, and saving processed data as pickles. No additional feature engineering is performed beyond raw text. The model uses a DistilRoBERTa transformer from HuggingFace with a classification head. Training uses 5-fold stratified cross-validation, AdamW optimizer, cosine schedule with warmup, gradient accumulation (2 steps), mixed precision (AMP), and early stopping (patience=3) based on validation loss. Predictions are clipped and normalized before computing log loss. Final submission averages test predictions across folds.
